comment: Source of truth for level geometry, loaded by both the Python trainer and the TypeScript client. Coordinates are grid cells. 'blocks' are filled rectangles {x, y, w, h}; 'cells' are individual [x, y] pairs. User-designed boards use this same schema.

levels.name: Scattered Blocks
levels.comment: Ported from the original _generate_obstacles_level2, converted from pixels to cells. The original filtered obstacles near spawn at runtime; the spawn corridor is instead kept clear by construction and checked by the loader.

levels.name: Corridors
levels.comment: Vertical walls with staggered gaps. Forces committed routing rather than local greedy moves.

levels.name: Shifting Ground
levels.comment: Procedurally generated from the episode seed, so the layout differs every game. This is the level that teaches obstacle avoidance as a skill rather than a memorised map, which is what the level designer mode depends on.
